about: A machine of your own: cmux's daemon on it, reached with {on} (`sh -c` on the machine itself, `ssh HOST` from another), and one agent turn placed there by acpmux (`--machine {machine}`). No pause or resume. Set on, cmux (the cmux binary on that machine) and machine.

agent_turn.run: acpmux run --machine {machine} -m claude/haiku --ephemeral --on-permission fail --timeout 150 'Reply with exactly the word PONG and nothing else.'
